main_body: red upholstered armchair: backrest block on top, seat cushion between two arms below, two short brown legs
top_band: Top of the backrest is light pink at rows 2-3, but it reads as the rounded backrest face. The seat top is a light pink band at rows 8-9, only about 2 rows and the same family of pink as the front.
evidence: In the middle column the rows run: dark outline (1), light pink (2-3), mid pink (4-6), dark line (7), light pink (8-9), mid and dark pink front (10-11), then dark outline and brown legs (12-13). The backrest and the seat cushion are both seen face-on as stacked vertical panels. The seat has only a 2px lighter band with no distinct front-edge highlight and no shadow under it, so it is too thin to read as a surface seen from above. This matches the guide's 'thin seat' and front-elevation failures.

style.evidence: The outline is a dark red-brown tinted to the material, which is good. The pink ramp has only about 3 steps (light, mid, dark). The cushion and backrest are flat fills with no dots, grain or stitching. Each tile carries only about 3-5 colours, well below the stall and well references, which have rich tile scallops, stone shading and wood grain.
